name: ios-factory
description: Onboard iOS apps onto shared PR checks and App Store Connect, and ship App Store releases interactively. Builds run on Xcode Cloud.

asc_key_id.title: App Store Connect Key ID
asc_key_id.description: App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → Team Keys (App Manager role or higher).

asc_issuer_id.title: App Store Connect Issuer ID
asc_issuer_id.description: Shown above the Team Keys table.

asc_key_path.title: App Store Connect key file (.p8)
asc_key_path.description: Path to the downloaded AuthKey .p8. Only the path is stored; the key itself is never read into Claude's context. Suggested home: ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/
